The Life-Changing Power Of Dental Implants
Request Appointment
Getting Dental Implants? Make Sure You Have A 3D Scan First | Arvada Dental Center
Open A New Chapter With A Smile

If you’re fed up with the embarrassment of missing teeth, struggles to eat the foods you love, and constantly hiding your smile, Arvada Dental Center has a lasting solution for you⁠ — affordable dental implants in Arvada, CO. We provide a variety of teeth replacement options to suit all your needs and smile goals, from full mouth dental implants to single implant placements. We also offer a range of dental financing options to help you manage the cost of dental implants. Leave the shame of missing teeth behind and let our experienced team transform your smile with dental implant surgery!

Get Pricing
Dental Implants Mimic Natural Teeth

Dental implants provide a permanent solution to restore the function and aesthetics of your smile. A dental implant consists of three parts that mimic natural teeth: a titanium or zirconium post, similar to tooth roots attached inside your jawbone; an abutment which sits on top of the post; and the restoration or crown that is attached to the abutment. In the period following your surgery, the dental implant fuses with your jawbone, which gives you a secure, gorgeous smile.

Request Appointment
Consider Your Tooth Replacement Options
Single Tooth Implant

Missing a single tooth can ruin your confidence and lead to significant oral health problems. If you’ve experienced trauma or tooth decay, your teeth may shift, affecting your jaw alignment. You also may have difficulty speaking. However, you don’t have to feel ashamed anymore. Our team can replace your tooth and replace your missing tooth with a single implant.

Multiple Teeth Replacement

We offer a range of options if you’ve lost more than one tooth. Aside from partial dentures, which require messy adhesives and dietary restrictions, we can replace multiple teeth with bridges and crowns. The best solution for multiple missing teeth is same-day dental implants. Get the gorgeous, natural-looking smile you’ve been waiting for without delay.

Implant Supported Denture

Implant supported dentures attach to surgically implanted posts, which provide more stability than traditional dentures. However, they are not as aesthetically appealing as full mouth dental implants. Hybrid dentures also limit your food choices compared to implants.

 

Full Arch Dental Implants

If most or all of your teeth are decayed or missing, we can place a whole new set of teeth in a single visit. You can receive your full mouth dental implants the same day as your dental implant surgery. He surgically places four or more implants securely to your jawbone, using fully guided All-on-X techniques for accuracy and precision. Our skilled dentist is also trained and certified to administer IV sedation, which allows for a pain-free and comfortable procedure.

Implant Restoration And Replacement

Arvada Dental Center can also restore your failing dental implants. We can help you treat or prevent peri-implantitis with laser gum surgery and periodontal maintenance. If they cannot be saved, we’ll provide high-end replacements. Our team will return your smile to its former brilliance with a customized treatment plan! 

Get Pricing
Dr. Bennett Talks About Dental Implants
Receiving Your New Smile

At Arvada Dental Center, we streamline your treatment process. We begin with a dental implant consultation to assess your oral health and smile goals. Once you and Dr. Bennett agree that you’re a candidate for dental implants, we capture images of your mouth and jaw to create a detailed surgical plan, including precise placement for each dental implant. Dr. Bennett may recommend preliminary treatments to ensure the success of your dental implants. We provide comprehensive in-house dental services, including bone grafting and teeth extractions, so you don’t have to see multiple providers.

Our skilled dentist is also board-certified to provide IV sedation to ensure your complete comfort. Once he administers anesthesia, he’ll perform your teeth extractions and begin your surgery, which takes 1-2 hours for each dental implant. You should expect your surgery to last several hours for full mouth dental implants. We ensure the precision and accuracy of each dental implant with fully guided All-on-X techniques. You can receive same-day dental implants and go home with a fully functional, brand-new smile!

Over the next few months, your dental implants integrate with your jawbone, forming a bond that mimics natural teeth. Most patients experience minimal to no pain, so you can eat and smile confidently. The dental implant healing process takes three months or more. Once fully healed, you’ll visit our office to receive final custom restorations for a lasting, gorgeous smile!
